questions.q: Why must the Power BI scheduled refresh run strictly AFTER both the nightly warehouse load and Chapter 3's Python validation finish?
options: Power BI Service requires a minimum 24-hour delay after any SQL Server write
Refreshing before validation could show Executives a dashboard reflecting data nobody has checked yet
The order makes no real difference as long as all three run once a day
Scheduled refresh cannot run more than once every 48 hours
questions.explain: Running the Power BI refresh only after the load and validation both finish means that by the time anyone opens the dashboard, that night's data has already passed every check.

questions.q: What role does an On-premises Data Gateway play in this deliverable?
options: It encrypts the Power BI report file for storage
It bridges the cloud-based Power BI Service to the on-premises SQL Server warehouse, which Power BI Service otherwise can't reach for a scheduled refresh
It replaces the need for a scheduled refresh entirely
It is only needed for DirectQuery models, never Import mode
questions.explain: Power BI Service is cloud-hosted; without a gateway installed on a machine with network access to SQL Server, a scheduled refresh has no way to actually reach dw.FactProductSales.

questions.q: What does publishing to the Power BI Service allow Executives to do that they couldn't do with only the Power BI Desktop file?
options: Edit the underlying DAX measures directly in a browser
Open the report from a browser or the Power BI mobile app, without needing Power BI Desktop installed
Write data back into the warehouse
Automatically generate the Tableau and Excel deliverables
questions.explain: Publishing makes the report accessible from a browser or mobile app, which matters for a dashboard meant to be opened and clicked through live in a meeting.

questions.q: What does finishing this lesson actually mean for the overall capstone?
options: The entire capstone is complete
Only the Power BI deliverable for Executives is complete — Chapters 5 and 6 still have to build the Tableau and Excel deliverables independently
The warehouse no longer needs validation
Tableau and Excel can now read directly from the Power BI model instead of the warehouse
questions.explain: Each front-end is built to completion on its own; finishing Power BI's deliverable doesn't finish the Board's or Finance's, which still read independently from the same warehouse.

questions.q: In the suggested nightly timing table, what order do the three steps run in?
options: Power BI refresh, then warehouse load, then validation
Validation, then warehouse load, then Power BI refresh
Warehouse load, then validation, then Power BI refresh
All three run simultaneously at the same scheduled time
questions.explain: The load has to finish first, then validation checks that load, and only then does the Power BI refresh pull in data that's already known-good.
